comment: The documentation screenshots and the website's close-up stills (outputs with `dest: site`, written to site/media/) as named target STATES. A scene may render supersampled (`render_scale` 1..4, the simulator's PLXNATIVE_RENDER_SCALE) and an output may `crop` ([x, y, w, h] in CANVAS pixels, whatever the scale), resample to `size` (never changing the crop's shape) and set a JPEG `quality`. tools/screenshots.py boots the simulator once per scene against tests/mock_pms.py --catalog, arms the scene's triggers (each one a file in a fresh instance root), waits for the settled capture (PLXNATIVE_SHOT_SETTLE) and then checks that every `expect` line is in the event log before it writes a single output. Triggers are the app's own dev triggers (docs/agent-reference.md lists them); nothing here sends a key. `token` and `plextv` are armed on every scene by the driver, so no run ever reaches a real server or plex.tv. --check-determinism captures each scene twice: every channel of every pixel may differ by at most `max_delta` (default 1: the GPU's run-to-run rounding in the blur and glass passes; scenes without them come back byte-identical), except inside a scene's `free_regions` ([x, y, w, h] in canvas pixels), which must say why in `tolerance_reason`.

scenes.name: home
scenes.state: Home at rest: the catalog's hero film pinned in hero slot 0 (the head of Continue Watching, so its button reads Continue), the deck's first shelf peeking below.

scenes.name: home-shelves
scenes.state: Home with focus on the first Continue Watching card: the card grown, its title and time-left line beneath it.

scenes.name: item-menu
scenes.state: The press-and-hold card menu open on the first Continue Watching card.

scenes.name: account-menu
scenes.state: The account menu open over a LANDED Home (the menu waits for 800 ms of rest, so the hero backdrop is in).

scenes.name: library
scenes.state: The Movies library at the top of its page, as it opens: the Continue Watching shelf with focus on its first card (the catalog's hero, captioned with its time left), Recently Added Movies below.

scenes.name: library-grid
scenes.state: The Movies library scrolled to its All grid, focus on the third card of the first row, toolbar visible.
expect: libgrid: focus seated at row 0 col 2

scenes.name: library-sort
scenes.state: The Movies grid with its Sort menu open (opened after 800 ms of rest, so the grid under it has finished scrolling).
expect: libgrid: focus seated at row 0 col 3

scenes.name: search
scenes.state: Search for "an" (the app's two-character minimum): the query, the scope line, and the two result shelves the mock gives — Movies, the films of the Animation genre the query matches (related results, as the spec documents: Spring, Sintel, Sprite Fright, Charge, …), then Episodes whose titles have a word beginning "an" (Hubblecast: 26th anniversary; Hubble, exoplanets and the hunt for life; Light: Mars and Saturn; …).

scenes.name: detail
scenes.state: The detail page of Tears of Steel (ratingKey 105), part-watched, so its primary action reads Resume.

scenes.name: signin
scenes.state: The QR sign-in screen with the mock's pin: code DEMO and a QR that the mock generated (it encodes https://plex.tv/link). No token is armed on this scene.

scenes.name: failure
scenes.state: The playback failure read-out, forced by the failtest trigger over a real start of Sintel (ratingKey 102). No clock sink, so nothing plays under it and the screen comes to rest.

scenes.name: player
scenes.state: The player HUD, paused at 7:26 of Sintel (ratingKey 102, the complete 14:48 film) on a close-up of Sintel, its Chapters tab beside Info: the clock sink plays the file the mock serves from the resume point (7:15), simvideo decodes it under the UI, and autopause pauses once the published playhead reaches 7:26.02 — mid-frame, where the clock sink is told to stop, so the pause freezes the same frame, clock and knob every run.

scenes.name: site-library
scenes.state: The website's glass and tiles close-ups, supersampled 3x. The Movies library with focus on the third card of Recently Added Movies (Sprite Fright, captioned with its year, between Charge and Spring), so the Continue Watching posters above it have scrolled up under the tab bar and fill it edge to edge (Tears of Steel, Metropolis, The General). Crops in canvas pixels: the bar from 8 canvas px left of its left end (the hand-cut framing, matched on the tab labels to 0 px), and the three shelf cards with the caption under the focused one (matched on the card edges to 0-1 px). The tiles output is resampled to 0.75x: the page shows it at most 698 CSS px wide through the phone crop, which needs 1866 px at DPR 2, not 2540.
expect: libshelf: focus seated on shelf 1 col 2

scenes.name: site-glass-narrow
scenes.state: The website's phone crop of the glass close-up: the same state as site-library, supersampled 4x, cut from 13 canvas px left of the bar's left end (where the hand cut began). 4x because the phone layout shows it up to 698 CSS px wide, 1396 px at DPR 2, which the 3x cut (1120 px) could not fill.
expect: libshelf: focus seated on shelf 1 col 2

scenes.name: site-up-next
scenes.state: The website's Up Next close-up, supersampled 3x: Caminandes S1 E2 (Gran Dillama) playing on the clock sink, with no video decoded (a black ground, as the hand cut had) from the demo library's black stand-in file of the episode's length, stopped by clockstop at 2:55.75 while still PLAYING (a pause would take the tile down), inside the last 30 s where the app offers the next episode because the continuous PlayQueue has S1 E3 (Llamigos) after it. stillclock holds the countdown at 4 s of 10. The crop puts the two buttons where the hand cut had them (matched on their labels to 0 px) and the playhead knob under the same pixel column (1 px). Resampled to 0.75x: the page shows it at most 698 CSS px wide, 1396 px at DPR 2.
scenes.tolerance_reason: Measured over four capture pairs: about one run in three, the rim of the Next Episode button (its glass edge, sampled at 3x) comes back 2 levels apart on some 1400 pixels; every other pixel stays within 1.
